profile_text.body:
Course Hero is an education technology company founded in 2006 and headquartered in Redwood City. Its own site describes it as offering instant access to millions of Study Resources, Course Notes, Test Prep, 24/7 Homework Help, and Tutors, with the stated aim of helping users learn, teach, and study. The site also carries sample course questions, including one on hypothesis types and one on incremental earnings from a promotional campaign, and notes that Course Hero is a Learneo, Inc. business.

The company's tracked product is QuillBot, listed under Writing & Editing with a note of paraphrasing. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for Course Hero.
